subject: Ciências
description_pt: Caracterizar os principais ecossistemas brasileiros quanto à paisagem, à quantidade de água, ao tipo de solo, à disponibilidade de luz solar, à temperatura etc., correlacionando essas características à flora e fauna específicas.

components.description_pt: Descrever paisagem, clima e características do solo de cada ecossistema brasileiro major
components.description_en: Describe the landscape, climate, and soil characteristics of each major Brazilian ecosystem
components.cc_component_description: Describe how environmental characteristics of an area influence which organisms can live there

components.description_pt: Identificar flora e fauna típicas de cada ecossistema brasileiro major
components.description_en: Identify the flora and fauna typical of each major Brazilian ecosystem
components.cc_component_description: Identify biotic and abiotic factors that determine the carrying capacity of an ecosystem

components.description_pt: Correlacionar fatores abióticos (disponibilidade de água, luz solar, temperatura, tipo de solo) à biodiversidade específica de um ecossistema brasileiro
components.description_en: Correlate abiotic factors (water availability, sunlight, temperature, soil type) to the specific biodiversity of a given Brazilian ecosystem
components.cc_component_description: Identify biotic and abiotic factors that influence the survival of an organism in an ecosystem

components.description_pt: Comparar dois ou mais ecossistemas brasileiros baseado em características físicas e biológicas
components.description_en: Compare two or more Brazilian ecosystems based on their physical and biological characteristics
components.cc_component_description: Compare the variety of plant and animal species found across two or more different habitats

cc_matches.description: Make observations of plants and animals to compare the diversity of life in different habitats.
There are many different kinds of living things in any area, and they exist in different places on land and in water.
Use mathematical and/or computational representations to support explanations of factors that affect carrying capacity of ecosystems at different scales.
Organisms, and populations of organisms, are dependent on their environmental interactions both with other living things and with nonliving factors.
